summary: Edesa Biotech filed a 424B5 on August 20, 2026, for a $25.0M firm-commitment underwritten offering of 3,870,500 common shares and 675,000 pre-funded warrants, each bundled with 18-month common warrants at a $7.50 strike. The combined price is $5.50 per unit, a 4.3% discount to the August 19 close of $5.75. Underwriting discounts of $0.33 per unit yield $23.5M net proceeds. A 30-day option covers 681,825 additional shares. This routine shelf takedown, not a special situation, funds Phase 2 vitiligo data. Watch warrant terms and potential dilution.
